newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain official shot dead in ministry office.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain official shot dead in ministry office.

text.p: A military official at Bahrain's interior ministry was shot dead on Monday in a dispute with another military man, an information ministry official said.
He said the shooting occurred in the office of the victim, identified by the official as Khalil Sa'ati. It was not known what rank he held.
The dispute was a personal matter between the two men, he said.
The government was investigating the incident, he added. No further details were available.
